hostNotes: Accept anyone who played a senior VFL/AFL or AFLW game, including coaches who played first (Sheedy, Clarkson, Malthouse, Beveridge, Thompson); reject coach-only names (Fagan, Jeans counts as he played) and umpires. Surname-only answers are fine, but shared surnames need a follow-up before scoring: Ablett (Sr or Jr), Josh Kennedy (Eagles or Swans), Riewoldt, Daicos, Selwood, Rioli, Scott, Kelly, Brown, Daniher and "Daisy" (Pearce or Thomas). Be forgiving on spelling; match phonetically. A real player not in this bank is still correct, so verify quickly and treat them as a deep cut.
